r-provenance.summary: Named semantic provenance domain is a handwritten union rather than an annotated LiteralKit.
r-provenance.fix: Define a module-local $I-annotated Provenance = LiteralKit with the seven existing strings and derive type Provenance = typeof Provenance.Type; preserve node construction and exhaustive dispatch.

r-table-origin.summary: Reused resolution-table origin domain has no schema authority.
r-table-origin.fix: Define a module-local $I-annotated LiteralKit for root, explicit, implicit, dotted and element; derive ResTable.origin from its Type and preserve every assignment, insertion rule and rendered byte.

r-format-invariant.summary: S3 replaced the law-forced tagged intoTable invariant error with a native Error from Option.getOrThrow and changed its message.
r-format-invariant.fix: Restore intoTable to the upstream branch structure with the S1 diagnostic/law adaptations: array-tables yield their last element with the missing-element TomlFormatInvariantError guard; table nodes pass through; other inputs throw TomlFormatInvariantError.make with the exact upstream invariant message. Preserve forced Effect collections and tagged carriers. Restore any upstream test lines rewritten specifically for this simplification; the inspected intoTable hunk rewrote no tests.

r-offset-metadata.summary: TomlOffsetDateTime.offsetMinutes lacks the field annotation required by operator step 4.
r-offset-metadata.fix: Add annotateKey with a meaningful description of the signed UTC offset in minutes, bounds -1439 through 1439, and zero rendering as Z; retain S.Int and the current range check.

r-range-check-metadata.summary: The seven reused calendar/time range checks lack required identifier, title and description annotations.
r-range-check-metadata.fix: Pass meaningful identifier, title and description annotations to each S.isBetween check in dateFields and timeFields, deriving identifiers from $I; preserve all numeric bounds, annotateKey descriptions and the calendar filter.
